locked.description: Set by DevOS when the filter is enabled system-wide: the user cannot switch it off or make it less strict.

enabled.description: Default on/off state when not locked.

mode.description: women: blur media showing a face classified as female. people: blur media showing any face.

femaleThreshold.description: Blur when the probability of a female face is at least this value (0-1, default 0.35).
